course_name_original: KMM2622 \u2014 Kimya Mühendisleri i\u00e7in Malzeme Bilimi

learning_outcomes.text: To have detailed knowledge about materials.
To have detailed knowledge about material applications by working in interdisciplinary groups.
To have knowledge about selecting appropriate materials for operating conditions.
The ability to conduct resource research using databases and other information sources related to any material.
To be able to write reports related to selected materials.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to materials science, history, innovations in materials and engineering
Thermodynamic aspects of stability, ideal gases, Phase equilibria of pure materials
Mechanical properties of ceramics and polymers
Hardness and other mechanical properties of materials
bibliography: Fundamentals of Materials Science and Engineering William D. Callister and David G. Rethwisch John Wiley 2008
